channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Karan Kundrra's ex goes Instagram official with Gaurav Kapur; men Kritika Kamrahas dated in past
item.description: As Kritika Kamra is now dating Gaurav Kapur, she earlier grabbed headlines for her relationship with her Kitani Mohabbat Hai co-star Karan Kundrra. She also dated Jackky Bhagnani for a short span. On the other hand, it has been widely reported that Gaurav was previously married to actor and model Kirat Bhattal.

item.title: Seven trucks of subsidized rice vanish in J&K: Crime Branch exposes major rice theft scam in Kashmir
item.description: The Economic Offences Wing of the Crime Branch Kashmir, has unearthed a major rice diversion scam involving officers of the Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department and the Food Corporation of India. Seven truckloads of subsidized rice meant for poor families were fraudulently shown as delivered and then illegally sold in the market.

item.title: Trump unveils Gold Card to retain top foreign talent in US
item.description: Speaking at a White House roundtable with leading technology CEOs on Wednesday (local time), Trump said the initiative would give firms "certainty" in hiring highly trained international students, many of whom face years-long immigration hurdles despite graduating at the top of their class.

item.title: Delhi's air quality slips further, edges close to 'very poor' mark again
item.description: As of 7 a.m., at least ten monitoring stations across the city registered AQI levels above 300, placing them in the very poor range. At Anand Vihar, the AQI stood at 300, Ashok Vihar 328, Chandni Chowk 305, and ITO 309.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty turn volatile at open amid US Fed rate cut
item.description: The Sensex, which began the day slightly higher, soon slipped into the red and was trading at 84,312 during early trade, down 79 points or 0.09 per cent. The Nifty also erased its early gains and inched down to 25,750, lower by 8 points or 0.03 per cent.

item.title: US, India push deeper counterterrorism ties amid Pakistan concerns
item.description: During the House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on South and Central Asia hearing on the US–India strategic partnership here on Wednesday (local time), eminent American experts on South Asia warned that Pakistan's continued use of militant proxies and China's expanding footprint in the region demand deeper alignment between Washington and New Delhi.

item.title: Akshaye Khanna wanted to date Jayalalithaa, was ready to marry Karisma Kapoor [Throwback]
item.description: There was a time when Akshaye Khanna wanted to date Jayalalithaa as he felt intrigued by her "secretive" nature. How he came close to marrying Karisma Kapoor.

item.title: Tanya Mittal's stylist accuses her of non-payment; says she's "tired of following up"
item.description: Tanya Mittal's stylist Riddhima Sharma has accused the Bigg Boss 19 contestant and her team of not releasing her payment for the sarees.

item.title: Hrithik Roshan reviews Dhurandhar, hails Aditya Dhar, disagrees with "politics" of it
item.description: Hrithik Roshan hailed Aditya Dhar for his storytelling in Ranveer Singh starrer Dhurandhar but added that he didn't agree with the politics of it.

item.title: Sachet – Parampara accuse Amaal Mallik of lying over 'Bekhayali' song, demand public apology
item.description: Bekhayali song row: Sachet - Parampara demand public apology from Amaal Mallik for claiming that the original tune of the song was composed by him.
